original_description: Pre-research for literature reviews, from topic to papers. Use this whenever someone gives a research title, thesis topic or research question and wants related literature found, or wants any of: Boolean search strings or keywords for Scopus (users may say "Opus"), Web of Science or Google Scholar; a broken, too-long or zero-result search string fixed; a systematic search run with hit counts recorded; a PRISMA 2020 flow diagram or search strategy report; title and abstract screening recorded; the papers downloaded (open access or via their library) into a folder; or a Literature Review Matrix (LRM, synthesis matrix, RRL) with IMRAD columns, journal quartiles (Q1-Q4) and method types. Also use it to classify or rank papers the user already has by quartile or methodology. Covers field tags, AND/OR/NOT, truncation, country niches, year ranges and Malay or other local-language strings. Not for writing the review itself, summarising a single paper, citation formatting, or general Boolean, regex or SQL help.
